Image via The Pokémon Company

Pokémon has spent decades finding new ways to redesign its original 151 creatures, from regional variants and Mega Evolutions to the increasingly crowded closets of costumed Pokémon in Pokémon GO. Pikachu may remain the franchise’s favorite model and icon to use, but Niantic has now selected someone with a little more muscle for its latest fashion experiment. There is only one problem. Unless players are willing to travel to Japan and purchase a ticket for an in-person event, they may not be able to add this bizarre new version to their collections.

Machamp wearing a modern jacket will debut during Pokémon GO Wild Area: Sendai・Tohoku, giving the four-armed Fighting-type an unexpectedly fashionable makeover. The costumed Pokémon will appear in three-star raids, while an exceptionally powerful “mighty” version can also be encountered in the wild during the event. Machamp wears an oversized jacket over its shoulders, wisely leaving all four arms outside its sleeves. The result looks somewhere between a professional fighter arriving for a championship match and someone making an extremely confident entrance at Fashion Week.

Unfortunately, Niantic’s announcement states that all gameplay featured during Pokémon GO Wild Area: Sendai・Tohoku will be exclusive to ticket holders. The event will only take place in Sendai and the wider Tohoku region of Japan, meaning international players would need to purchase a ticket and travel there for an opportunity to catch Machamp themselves. This does not necessarily mean jacket-wearing Machamp will remain region-locked forever. Costumed Pokémon introduced during major events sometimes become available again through later celebrations, and players could theoretically acquire one from someone who attended through trading. Dynamax Dialga and Dynamax Palkia will make their Pokémon GO debuts in Max Battles, while Hisuian Sliggoo and Hisuian Goodra will also appear in the mobile game for the first time. Mighty Bastiodon, Kommo-o, and Lapras will join the newly dressed Machamp in the wild, with GO Safari Balls available to improve players’ chances of catching them.

Pokémon GO Wild Area: Sendai・Tohoku runs from November 6 through November 8, 2026, between 10:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. JST each day. For everyone unable to make the trip, the wait begins to see whether Machamp eventually takes its new jacket on a worldwide tour.
